lead_action: ADD as a lead requiring curator verification
evidence_basis: Structural homology to nucleotide-bound COQ8A (TM 0.816), 11/12 validated nucleotide-site residues conserved, K183-E236 ion pair 2.73 A, ATP-sized pocket assembled, 17/20 positions >=95% conserved across 91 metazoan orthologs (p=4.5e-09)
proposed_evidence_code: ISS (ECO:0000250) or keep as IEA from PRU00159
caveats: No direct nucleotide-binding measurement on ADCK1 protein exists. K183I had no phenotype in the one assay run. Recommend 'lead, verify' not 'confirmed'

evidence_basis: Substrate groove is occluded by KxGQ and A-rich elements in the model; COQ8A is a lipid-stimulated ATPase and unlocking protein-kinase-like activity (A339G) breaks its native function; UniProt states ADCK1 acts in a kinase-independent manner
caveats: PMID:42990412 reports substrates for ADCK1 in a pooled screen and is the one competing line of evidence; revisit if purified-enzyme data appear

lead_action: HOLD; do not add without ADCK1 data
evidence_basis: COQ8A is an ATPase (PMID:29198567) and Cqd1/Cqd2 activities depend on the shared kinase/ATPase domain (PMID:34362905)
caveats: Transfer across a 27% identity paralog boundary into a different clade; not safe to annotate

evidence_basis: ADCK1 is not a COQ8 ortholog (27.2% to COQ8A vs 60.3% COQ8A-COQ8B); Drosophila ADCK1 mutants have normal basic metabolite levels (PMID:31175694); no reported CoQ defect
caveats: Family-name carry-over from the ADCK/AarF label is the main over-annotation risk here

evidence_basis: Direct loss- and gain-of-function in Drosophila and mammalian cells
caveats: Downstream of ADCK1 action via YME1L1; it is a pathway consequence, not the molecular function

lead_action: RETAIN, and consider upgrading if direct submitochondrial data exist
evidence_basis: GO:0005739 has IDA support (PMID:33988507); inner-membrane placement is IBA and matches Cqd1 (PMID:37073556)
proposed_evidence_code: IBA; IDA if submitochondrial fractionation is published
caveats: Membrane topology of ADCK1 itself has not been reported
